title: Servicenow application portfolio management (apm) & data quality engineer - contractor in usd
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Servicenow application portfolio management (apm) & data quality engineer - contractor in usd em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

For our international customer in Valencia, we are looking for a Service Now Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer. The role focuses on ongoing APM data maintenance in Service Now (APM/CMDB-related records as applicable), identifying data gaps and inconsistencies, coordinating updates with application/service owners, and tracking technical debt indicators and remediation progress.

EU candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates need to be based in Valencia or willing to relocate to Valencia. Candidates need to be flexible to work across time zones, including alignment with US Eastern Time where required.

Work permit is not provided. Candidates need to be fluent in English.

Tasks and responsibilities:

Perform ongoing maintenance of Application Portfolio Management (APM) data within Service Now, including application inventory, ownership, lifecycle status, technology attributes, and documented integrations/dependencies, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and currency; Identify and remediate data quality issues such as missing or invalid values, duplicate records, and inconsistent classifications through coordination with application owners, service owners, and relevant stakeholders; Maintain and enhance portfolio data governance standards and controlled vocabularies, including lifecycle states, business and technical fit assessments, and application criticality classifications; Monitor and track technical debt indicators leveraging Service Now portfolio data, including lifecycle and obsolescence risks, unsupported technologies, architectural non-conformities, and resilience or operability gaps; Maintain a centralized log or aligned Service Now records documenting technical debt items, including impacted applications/services, severity and priority ratings, and recommended remediation actions such as retirement, replacement, or modernization; Develop and deliver recurring dashboards, reports, and portfolio insights for the onsite Enterprise Architect, including technical debt trends, aging remediation items, progress tracking, and portfolio risk hotspots; Translate stakeholder inputs, priorities, and publishing schedules into updates for the APM website and related communication materials; Maintain and support the APM website as a central platform for publishing portfolio data, standards, insights, lifecycle guidance, and reference information related to Application Portfolio Management practices;

Profile:

Master's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline; +8 years of overall experience in Information Technology; +3 years of experience supporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams; Hands-on experience with Service Now, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting; Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize); Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights; Solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target-state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision-making; Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and drive timely completion of application and portfolio record updates; Previous experience delivering similar Service Now APM and technical debt management activities within large or complex enterprise environments is highly preferred; Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving capabilities, including experience producing dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and trend analysis with a strong focus on data integrity and attention to detail; AI literacy, including practical experience using AI and Generative AI tools to enhance productivity in areas such as data analysis, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management, within approved enterprise governance frameworks; Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders; Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes; Working knowledge of Service Now data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices; Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including:

TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification;

Service Now Certified System Administrator (CSA);

Service Now Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant Service Now implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB;

Experience with enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including Service Now EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities, is considered a plus; Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information, is considered an advantage; Fluent in English;

title: Data engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description

First Ignite develops AI-powered tools designed to support universities in key areas such as Tech Transfer, Corporate Relations, Advancement, Career Development, and Research Development. These tools empower universities to expand their initiatives and streamline operations effectively. First Ignite is dedicated to helping academic institutions grow and thrive through innovative technological solutions, making a meaningful impact in the education sector.

Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Data Engineer. The Data Engineer, will lead the design, development, and maintenance of scalable data systems focused on acquiring, structuring, and integrating diverse datasets from external and internal sources. This role will be responsible for building reliable data acquisition pipelines, including crawling, scraping, API ingestion, data mining, enrichment, and ETL workflows that turn messy public or semi-public sources into accurate, usable data for First Ignite's platform.

Qualifications

Lead the architecture, development, and optimization of scalable data pipelines for patents, grants, clinical trials, publications, labs, and firmographic sources. Build and maintain ETL workflows on AWS using Glue (Py Spark), Lambda, S3, and RDS Postgre SQL. Explore and implement complementary data storage solutions as needed. Apply machine learning and LLM-based techniques to extract, structure, and enrich data at scale. Ensure data integrity, security, accuracy, and governance across all systems. Implement tools for data exploration, visualization, and actionable insights. Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to drive AI-driven innovation. Evaluate emerging AI/ML techniques and tools to enhance platform capabilities. Maintain version control, CI/CD pipelines, and reproducible workflows for the data engineering team.

Requirements

Strong programming expertise in Python, with experience building production data pipelines. Hands-on experience with AWS data services (Glue/Py Spark, Lambda, S3, RDS Postgre SQL, SSM) or equivalent cloud data stacks. Strong experience with external data acquisition, including building and maintaining crawlers, scrapers, API integrations, and data mining workflows that turn messy public or semi-public sources into reliable, structured datasets. This includes handling rate limits, source changes, deduplication, validation, enrichment, and pipeline monitoring. Familiarity with RESTful and Graph QL APIs, ETL processes, and data integration strategies. Understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and AI-enhanced data applications. Strong analytical skills, including evaluating trade-offs of data ingestion and storage methods. Leadership experience managing data engineering or AI teams in Saa S or tech environments. Solid knowledge of version control (Git) and CI/CD practices. Excellent problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills in cross-functional teams. Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and drive projects from conception to deployment.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with web scraping at scale (Firecrawl or similar). LLM-based data extraction and prompt engineering for structured output. Data quality instrumentation and observability for pipelines.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent acquisition specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Talent Acquisition Specialist

Role Overview

We are seeking a proactive and adaptable Talent Acquisition Specialist with experience recruiting across multiple industries and mid-level roles, including global and remote hiring.

This role is critical to building a high-quality, scalable team. You will partner closely with hiring managers across departments to identify talent needs, run efficient hiring processes, and bring in candidates who align with both skill requirements and company culture.

title: Data engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Data Engineer (Databricks & AWS)

Remote (Latin America / Europe) | 9 AM - 5 PM EST | Full-time

At Cloud Geometry, we partner with industry leaders like AWS, Google, and Databricks to deliver cutting-edge cloud-native solutions. We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our flagship project: a modern Data Platform for the life sciences industry, supporting global leaders like Pfizer, Moderna, and Novartis in developing innovative RNA-based solutions using cloud computing and advanced AI.

If you are an experienced data engineer who thrives in high-impact environments, zeroes out legacy systems, and wants to play a key technical leadership role in building scalable lakehouse architectures, let's talk!

Key Responsibilities

Pipeline Engineering: Design, develop, and optimize high-performance ETL pipelines within Databricks to connect analytics-ready data back to operational services. Architecture Leadership: Lead technical architecture discussions with engineering, product managers, and data scientists to implement advanced analytics. Workflow Optimization: Build, fine-tune, and monitor Databricks workflows to ensure system reliability, performance, and data integrity. Data Quality & Security: Collaborate with ML teams to ensure secure, rigorous, and accurate data ingestion across all processing stages. Agile Execution: Actively participate in daily Scrum ceremonies within a globally distributed engineering team.

Technical Requirements & Stack

1. Core Data Engineering

Databricks Ecosystem: 2+ years of hands-on experience (Delta tables/Iceberg, Spark jobs, MLflow, Unity Catalog, Model Registry). Architecture: Expert-level understanding of modern Lakehouse architectural design principles. Languages: Expert-level Python (for data processing/ETL) AND Type Script / Node.js (for backend services using Hapi JS, Zod, and Jest).

2. Cloud Infrastructure & Dev Ops (AWS)

Compute & Storage: ECS (Fargate/EC2), Lambda, S3, and Athena. Messaging & Orchestration: SQS/SNS and Airflow. Dev Ops & CI/CD: Git Hub Actions, Code Build, Docker, and repository templates via Cruft.

3. Data Stores & MLOps

Databases: Postgre SQL (ACID/Migrations), Dynamo DB (High-scale Key-Value), and Redis (Caching/Rate limiting). Search: Open Search / Elasticsearch for full-text search and aggregations. Gen AI: Practical knowledge of LLMs, agents, function calling, and RAG architectures.

Qualifications

Experience: 5+ years in software development with a strong focus on data engineering/analytics teams. Senior Autonomy: Proven ability to challenge decisions, propose architectural improvements, and deliver complex features end-to-end. Communication: Exceptional English skills (written and spoken) to articulate complex data ideas to global stakeholders. Availability: Required online presence from 9 AM to 5 PM EST.

Nice to Have:

Professional Databricks or AWS certifications. Experience building internal SDKs or developer experience tooling. Experience working directly alongside Data Scientists and ML Developers.

What We Offer (Our Commitment to You)

Comprehensive compensation and benefits package. Zero legacy systems – work exclusively with cutting-edge technologies. Continuous Learning: Extensive training, certifications, hackathons, and Udemy access. Premium Tooling: Developer Pro access to Claude Code, Codex, and Anti Gravity. Top-tier Culture: A collaborative, supportive environment with global experts.

Ready to build the future of Life Sciences?

Click Apply or send us your resume. Let's build something massive together!

title: Azure .net engineer
description:

20+ years exp as a. NET Engineer

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Work Hours: U. S. Eastern Time Zone (ET) ± 1 hour

Role Overview

We are seeking a senior nearshore engineer based in Brazil with deep, hands-on Azure development experience, focused on modernizing enterprise. NET/C# applications into Azure-native architectures, with a primary emphasis on Azure Functions and supporting Azure services.

This role supports large-scale enterprise and cloud modernization initiatives. The ideal candidate has strong experience working in corporate environments, is comfortable in a nearshore delivery model, and can operate as a seamless extension of a U. S.-based engineering team.

Required Experience & Core Qualifications

10+ years of experience in enterprise / corporate technology environments Strong Azure development background, with production experience in Azure-native services Proven experience supporting U. S.-based or English-speaking organizations (or English-language higher education) – nice to have Strong verbal and written English communication skills Experience working in a near-shore or distributed delivery model Ability to align working hours with U. S. Eastern Time (ET) ± 1 hour Reliable home office setup (monitor and keyboard required; laptop provided)

Primary Technical Focus (Must Have)

Azure &. NET Development (Primary Focus)

. NET / C# Deep experience with. NET Framework and. NET Core /. NET Strong C# development fundamentals in enterprise environments Azure Functions Hands-on experience designing, building, and maintaining Azure Functions Experience refactoring or modernizing existing. NET applications into serverless or Azure-native architectures Familiarity with triggers, bindings, scaling, error handling, and monitoring Core Azure Services Practical experience with services commonly used alongside Azure Functions, such as: Azure App Service Azure Storage (Blob, Queue, Table) Azure Service Bus or Event Grid Azure Key Vault Azure Monitor / Application Insights Cloud Readiness & Modernization Experience modernizing monolithic or legacy middleware into Azure-based solutions Understanding of cloud design patterns, resiliency, and scalability

Secondary Technical Focus (Strongly Preferred)

SQL Server & Data Platforms (Second Priority)

SQL Server (2016+) Strong experience with SQL Server in enterprise environments Exposure to on-premises to Azure SQL or Azure SQL Managed Instance migrations Experience modernizing: Linked servers SQL Agent jobs SSRS (SQL Server Reporting Services) SSAS experience is a plus Ability to design and optimize database interactions for cloud-based workloads

API, Security, and Front-End

API Development Experience with REST and SOAP services Understanding of API design best practices and documentation (Swagger / Open API) Authentication & Authorization Familiarity with enterprise authentication patterns: OAuth, SAML, Open ID Connect (OIDC) Azure Entra (Azure AD) Angular Experience supporting or maintaining Angular-based front-end applications Python Used for scripting, automation, or auxiliary workloads Azure Data Factory or other ETL tools

Supporting Skills (Nice to Have / Lower Priority)

Oracle (intermediate experience; exposure to migrations is a plus) Snowflake (familiarity with cloud analytics publishing patterns)

Engagement & Delivery Expectations

Operate as a contracted nearshore resource, integrated into an existing Azure delivery team Participate in Agile ceremonies, design discussions, and code reviews Follow enterprise standards for security, documentation, and SDLC Deliver high-quality, production-ready Azure solutions

title: Fullstack developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Fullstack developer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Description

We are looking for a versatile and talented Full-stack Developer to grow with our global development team. You will be working remotely on the main Assima platform application. Your key role will be to implement features and maintain our platform developed in C# and. NET framework.

There will be opportunities to work on the future version of our application as a backend developer (Python) or frontend (React), depending on priorities and skills.

Roles and Responsibilities

Develop and maintain features for our main platform Deploy code to production and respond to live incidents in production Work closely with developers and QA testers to deliver and meet expectations Work in an international environment with teams in multiple time zones Think out of the box and solve unique problems Attention to detail

Requirements

Core skills

3+ years of experience with C# Strong experience with. NET Framework (ASPX) and ASP. NET Experience with. NET Core / ASP. NET Core Experience with Microsoft SQL Server

Bonus

Experience with Entity Framework (EF / EF Core) Experience with WCF (Windows Communication Foundation) services Experience with Rabbit MQ or other message brokers Strong knowledge of Java Script, HTML, CSS, JQuery Understanding of asynchronous programming and multithreading Experience with TFS (Team Foundation Server) / Azure Dev Ops Familiarity with non-relational databases such as Mongo DB and Apache Solr

Special Requirements for the Role

Ability to work and communicate clearly and efficiently with team members, with strong English communication both written and spoken M. S. Degree in Computer Science or similar Work within a successful, dynamic, small and growing team Availability to work during CET business hours

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Direct-response ad video editor em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're looking for a direct response video editor who can produce 1-3 performance ads per day — consistently, quickly, and without hand-holding.

You'll receive reference ads, raw footage, AI-generated visuals, voiceover audio, product photography, UGC clips, and creative briefs. Your job is to turn those inputs into scroll-stopping Meta ads that look native to the feed, follow direct response principles, and are ready to launch same-day.

Some days you'll get a detailed brief with every asset handed to you. Other days you'll get a reference ad and a direction — and you'll need to reverse-engineer the structure, build a visual concept, and deliver a finished ad using your own creative instincts.

This is not a 9-to-5 editing job. This is a performance marketing role that happens to live inside an editing timeline.

What You'll Be Doing

Editing 1-3 short-form video ads per day (15-60 seconds) for Meta placements Working with a mix of UGC footage, AI-generated imagery, 3 D medical-style animations, product photography, voiceover tracks, and b-roll Receiving reference ads and reverse-engineering their pacing, structure, visual rhythm, and caption systems to build Velor Health versions Building ads from creative briefs that include scripts, shot lists, visual direction, and caption specs Originating new ad concepts when given only a direction or angle — proposing visual treatments, caption styles, and pacing without being told exactly what to do Implementing caption systems with color-coded text (white/red/blue pill captions, green keyword highlights, auto-generated Tik Tok-style captions) depending on the ad format Cutting multiple versions of the same ad (hook variants, length variants, aspect ratio variants) for A/B testing Maintaining a fast turnaround — most ads should go from brief to finished export within 2-4 hours Organizing and managing a growing library of raw assets, finished ads, and creative templates

What You Need

Proven experience editing direct response or performance marketing video ads (not brand content, not music videos, not wedding films — direct response ads that ran on Meta or Tik Tok with measurable results) Fluency in Cap Cut, Premiere Pro, or After Effects — whichever you're fastest in Strong understanding of Meta ad formats — you know what a native feed ad looks like versus a produced commercial, and you default to native Ability to match reference ad pacing intuitively — if we send you a competitor ad, you can deconstruct its cut timing, caption rhythm, and visual structure without being taught Comfort working with AI-generated imagery and integrating it seamlessly into live footage and product photography Experience with caption styling — you've built caption systems before (color-coded, keyword-highlighted, timed to VO) and you understand that captions are a conversion tool, not an accessibility afterthought A sharp eye for thumbnail-level scroll-stopping — you understand that the first frame of a video ad is a static image in the feed and you treat it accordingly Ability to self-manage, meet daily output targets, and communicate proactively when something is unclear or delayed Reliable internet connection and availability during US business hours (ET or CT preferred but flexible for the right person)

Bonus (Not Required)

Experience editing ads in the health, wellness, fitness, or DTC supplement space Familiarity with the \"ugly ad\" aesthetic — ads intentionally designed to look like organic UGC rather than polished production Experience with motion graphics or basic After Effects animation (for text overlays, simple transitions, or kinetic typography) Understanding of direct response copywriting principles (you know why a hook matters, why the product should appear early, why the CTA needs to sound like a peer recommendation)

What You Don't Need

A film degree A fancy reel of cinematic work Experience at a big agency Color grading expertise

We care about speed, instinct, and output quality at volume. If your best work is a single beautifully-graded 3-minute brand film, this isn't the right fit. If your best work is 47 Meta ads you cut last month that all drove profitable ROAS, we want to talk to you.

Compensation

Competitive rate based on experience. This is a contract role with potential to grow into a long-term position as the brand scales. We value speed and consistency — editors who hit daily output targets reliably will have no shortage of work.

How To Apply

There will be a paid test before any hire is made. Here's how it works:

Apply with your portfolio. Send 3-5 examples of direct response video ads you've edited that actually ran on Meta or Tik Tok. Tell us the niche, the objective, and the result if you have it. We don't need a sizzle reel — we need proof you've done this before. If your portfolio fits, we'll send you a paid test project. You'll receive a reference ad, a script, raw assets (footage, images, voiceover), and a creative brief. You'll have 24 hours to deliver a finished ad. This test is paid regardless of whether you're hired. We evaluate the test on four criteria: Did you match the pacing and structure of the reference? Did the first frame stop the scroll? Did the captions and visual rhythm support the VO? Did you deliver on time? If the test passes, you start with a one-week trial at 1 ad per day. If that week goes well, we scale to full output.

We're not looking for perfection. We're looking for someone who ships fast, learns from references quickly, and gets better with every ad they cut.

To apply, send your portfolio and a brief note about your direct response editing experience to (your email) with the subject line \"DR Editor — (Your Name).\"

description:

Company Description:

Million Logics is a trusted Oracle Partner and global leader in IT solutions, with operations in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. Specialising in innovative and scalable services, Million Logics empowers enterprises through data & AI, cloud solutions, IT consulting, and custom application development. With a team of 85+ AI/ML experts, we deliver tailored solutions that foster digital transformation and operational excellence. We are committed to client success. We blend world-class technical expertise with strategic insight to deliver results.

Role Overview:

As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalisation feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and You Tube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigour. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalised responses, evaluating dimensions such as Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.

Offer Details:

Duration of Contract: 6 months Pay: $1500 per month (net/take-home) Mode of work: Fully Remote Number of Positions: 20 Must have fluency in Portgutal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese )

Skills:

Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred. BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).

Key Qualifications:

Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portgutal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese ) with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project. Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment. Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team. Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalisation quality. Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities. Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalisation concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalisation, poor inferences, and forced connections. Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (Sx S) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and over-narrating. Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers. Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.

Description:

In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalised AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve: Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilise your personal information and experiences. Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalisation was appropriately applied. Analysing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations. Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"over-narrating\". Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (Sx S) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable. Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation. Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilised. Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.

Education & Experience:

BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field). Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.

Additional Details:

Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week, with 4 hours of overlap with PST. Engagement type: Contractor Engagement Length: 6 months

Master's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline; +8 years of overall experience in Information Technology; +3 years of experience supporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams; Hands-on experience with Service Now, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting; Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders; Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes; Working knowledge of Service Now data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices; TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification;

Service Now Certified System Administrator (CSA);

Service Now Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant Service Now implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB;

Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia. Valoriza - Programa de Recrutamento Interno: Para impulsionar sua carreira por meio de oportunidades internas. Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base. Nosso propósito é avançar cada vez mais, gerando empregabilidade para talentos diversos. Venha enriquecer nosso time!

title: Executivo comercial (salvador - ba seguros)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Executivo comercial (salvador - ba seguros) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a Lockton Fundada há mais de 50 anos por Jack Lockton em Kansas City, a Lockton desenvolveu uma marca internacionalmente reconhecida pela qualidade e eficiência nos serviços que oferecemos. Graças a lealdade de nossos clientes, que nos permitiu crescer expressivamente nos últimos anos, a Lockton hoje está entre as maiores corretoras de seguro do mundo, conquistando a taxa de crescimento orgânico mais rápida do mercado de corretoras Responsabilidades e Atribuições: Atenderá a carteira de clientes da região Norte e Nordeste. Atuará com renovação e new addition e novos negócios para a carteira, por meio da prospecção de novos clientes. Interface com a área técnica para realizar a colocação/cotação do risco e analisar as informações (cotações) encaminhadas pela área técnica. Acompanhará o andamento dos sinistros junto a área operacional. Realizará análise do risco dos clientes para identificar as melhores oportunidades de negócio. Apresentará propostas comerciais aos clientes. Realizará atendimento diário aos clientes, por meio do contato telefônico, e-mail ou visitas. Realizará a negociação e o fechamento da venda com o cliente. Quando necessário acompanhará todo o processo de renovação da apólice dos clientes. Realizará cadastro das informações sobre o cliente na ferramenta CRM (plooms). Requisitos e Qualificações: Conhecimento nas modalidades P&C, Financial Lines, Ricos de Engenharia, Garantia, Transportes e Benefícios. Experiência em seguradora ou corretora.

title: Analista de treinamento e desenvolvimento júnior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de treinamento e desenvolvimento júnior em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Treinamento e Desenvolvimento Júnior para integrar nosso time de Pessoas e Cultura, contribuindo para a construção de uma experiência de aprendizagem que apoie o desenvolvimento dos colaboradores e o alcance dos objetivos organizacionais. Se você é uma pessoa organizada, comunicativa, gosta de lidar com pessoas e tem interesse em desenvolvimento humano e educação corporativa, essa oportunidade pode ser para você! Principais Responsabilidades: Apoiar o levantamento de necessidades de treinamento (LNT), coletando informações junto às áreas, organizando dados e apoiando a consolidação das demandas de capacitação; Auxiliar na elaboração e acompanhamento do plano anual de treinamento e desenvolvimento; Organizar ações de treinamento e desenvolvimento, realizando agendamentos, reservas de espaços, controles administrativos e comunicação com participantes e fornecedores; Apoiar a execução de ações de desenvolvimento e capacitação, acompanhando cronogramas, recursos e necessidades operacionais para garantir a realização das atividades previstas; Realizar o controle de presença, emissão de certificados e registros das ações de treinamento; Aplicar avaliações de reação e apoiar a consolidação dos resultados e indicadores da área; Elaborar relatórios, apresentações e controles relacionados aos programas de treinamento e desenvolvimento; Apoiar programas de integração (onboarding) e iniciativas voltadas ao desenvolvimento dos colaboradores; Manter atualizados os registros, indicadores e documentações da área de T&D. Requisitos: Ensino Superior completo ou cursando em Psicologia, Administração, Gestão de Recursos Humanos, Pedagogia ou áreas correlatas; Experiência prévia em atividades administrativas de RH, Treinamento e Desenvolvimento ou áreas afins; Conhecimento do Pacote Office, com foco em Excel e Power Point; Boa comunicação verbal e escrita; Organização e atenção aos detalhes. Nossos benefícios: Vale-Transporte Refeitório no Local Plano de Saúde Plano Odontológico Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR) Informações da Vaga: Local: Salvador/BA Modalidade: Presencial Contratação: CLT Buscamos profissionais que acreditam no desenvolvimento contínuo das pessoas e desejam contribuir para a construção de uma cultura de aprendizagem e crescimento.

title: Assistente administrativo
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Assistente administrativo em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da Empresa Sugerimos que insira os detalhes aqui. Descrição do Cargo Estamos à procura de um Assistente Administrativo para se juntar ao time D MAIS EDUCAÇÃO em Salvador, BA. As responsabilidades do cargo incluem o suporte administrativo geral, atendimento telefônico com postura e educação, organização de documentos e realização de tarefas rotineiras de escritório. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e requer presença nas dependências da empresa. Qualificações Assistência Administrativa: Habilidade em prestar suporte administrativo e gerenciar tarefas comuns de escritório de forma organizada e eficiente. Etiqueta Telefônica: Experiência em atendimento telefônico com eficácia e cordialidade, garantindo boa comunicação com os diversos públicos da empresa. Comunicação: Capacidade clara e adequada para comunicar-se de forma verbal e escrita, essencial para interagir com diferentes equipes e partes interessadas. Gestão Administrativa e Clerical: Conhecimentos em tarefas administrativas de suporte executivo e habilidades clericais, como organização de documentos e controle de agendas. Experiência prévia comprovada na área administrativa e domínio do pacote Microsoft Office serão considerados diferenciais significativos.

title: Journalist/writer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Journalist/writer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

As Blueclip we started our journey to bring the most creative minds and the know-how together to deliver great works. Our current search is for a journalist/writer for entertainment content.

Your primary responsibility will be writing taglines and pinned comments for content creators and communicating with fans in comment sections.

Objectives:

Create a variety of text for various social networking networks (taglines, pinned comments, descriptions, etc). Use analytics to gain interesting insights and comments on your writing. Investigate the creator's universe and create customized writing standards. Assist other writers by acting as a copy editor, checking for adherence to guidelines, spelling, grammar, and so on. Take control of authors' comment sections by engaging (reacting and commenting) with followers.

What we are looking for:

Proficient in English, with excellent writing abilities and a keen eye for grammatical detail A background in journalism and enthusiasm for writing with prior experience in a comparable capacity (internships accepted) Excellent understanding of the key social media platforms (Facebook, Instagram, Tik Tok, Snapchat, and You Tube) Interested in content producers and trends, what's going on in cinematic universe Knowledge of how to examine data to make judgments Capable of working both individually and as part of a team Extremely structured and capable of successfully prioritizing in order to handle several creators at the same time

If you want to be a part of a dynamic multinational team just hit the apply button!

Please upload your English CV.

title: Enfermeiro
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Enfermeiro em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Vaga:

Enfermeiro(a) na Alemanha

Salário:

• +R$14.500,00 (+2.500 euros — inicial) + benefícios.

Localidade:

• Alemanha (Berlim, Munique ou outras cidades com demanda hospitalar — a definir conforme colocação)

Programa:

• Enfermanha - Enfermagem na Alemanha, da Sprache& Wissen.

Como funciona?

• Você participa de um processo seletivo e, se aprovado(a), estuda alemão por até 2 anos até atingir o nível B2 (intermediário completo). Você escolhe onde estudar — na escola da Sprache& Wissen (maior online de alemão da América Latina) ou em outra instituição validada. Concluída a etapa de estudos, dentro dos requisitos do programa, a S& W te conecta com sua oportunidade profissional na Alemanha.

Quem é a Sprache& Wissen?

• A Sprache& Wissen (S& W) é uma empresa brasileira fundada por dois irmãos mineiros: um administrador formado pelo CEFET-MG e uma professora de alemão doutora pela UFMG. O grupo educacional administra as marcas Clube de Alemão, Punkify e Vale-idiomas. A S& W é a maior escola online de alemão da América Latina, vai capacitar 100 mil brasileiros até 2030 nos idiomas alemão e inglês. Possui mais de 500 mil seguidores nas redes sociais e satisfação de 98,9%.

Principais atividades (na Alemanha):

• Cuidado direto ao paciente em ambiente hospitalar ou clínico

• Administração de medicamentos e acompanhamento de tratamentos

• Documentação clínica e comunicação com equipe multidisciplinar em alemão

• Participação em plantões conforme escala do empregador

Requisitos:

• Diploma de Enfermagem (bacharelado) reconhecido no Brasil

• Idade máxima de 36 anos (requisito do programa de visto alemão)

• Disponibilidade para estudar alemão por até 2 anos até o nível B2, com flexibilidade de horários

• Comprometimento com as etapas do programa

• Documentação em dia para solicitação de visto (passaporte válido ou possibilidade de emitir)

Diferenciais:

• Conhecimento prévio de alemão (qualquer nível)

• Experiência em UTI, emergência ou centro cirúrgico

• Experiência internacional ou intercâmbio

• Inglês intermediário ou avançado

Sobre o período de estudos:

• Você estuda alemão do Brasil enquanto se prepara para a mudança

• Mentoria em grupo durante toda a jornada até o B2

• Flexibilidade para conciliar com seu emprego atual

Etapas do processo:

1. Inscrição e triagem inicial

2. Reunião com o time da S& W

3. Questionários e aprovação

4. Planejamento de estudos

5. Curso de alemão (até o nível B2)

6. Match com recrutador alemão

7. Colocação profissional na Alemanha

title: Technology manager (licensed entities)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technology manager (licensed entities) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About Revolut
People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.
As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.
About the role
Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving forward. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do. We're looking for a Technology Manager to partner closely with local and global teams across Operations, Product, Risk, and Compliance on technology initiatives.
You'll ensure local technology frameworks, systems, and governance align with both group standards and Brazilian regulatory expectations.
Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.
What you'll be doing
Overseeing the implementation and evolution of the local technology architecture Contributing to the execution of the IT and data strategy Collaborating with global teams on technology transformations and system migrations Supporting IT governance processes, including documentation and reporting for local regulatory requirements Coordinating with internal stakeholders on technology initiatives related to regulatory compliance Helping ensure systems are scalable, reliable, and aligned with group technology standards Supporting operational processes and technology frameworks required for regulated financial entities in Brazil
What you'll need
5+ years of experience in technology, IT architecture, or technology governance within financial services or fintech Familiarity with regulatory and security requirements in Brazil, including cybersecurity, outsourcing, operational risk management, and data protection A bachelor's degree or equivalent in a relevant field, such as engineering, computer science, or information systems Great organisational and time management skills Knowledge of IT systems, infrastructure, or technology governance frameworks Solid analytical and problem-solving skills Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills Fluency in English
Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.
Important notice for candidates: Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles. •
Only apply through official Revolut channels.
We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment. •
Always double-check the emails you receive.
Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an@ domain. We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process.
If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

Dominar conceitos de Core Web Vitals, renderização no servidor (SSR), hidratação progressiva e estratégias de cache.

title: Talent acquisition partner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent acquisition partner em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Talent Acquisition Partner (Active Sourcing)
Location: Fully Remote (Must be based in LATAM) Job Type: Full-Time
About Uproot Clean Uproot Clean is a fast-growing consumer products company with more than 5 million customers using our products. Our products are sold not only through DTC and Amazon, but also through major retailers, including Walmart, Target, and Petco, along with more than 10,000 retail doors across the country. Uproot has also been featured across major television and media platforms, including QVC, Good Morning America, and Fox, helping introduce millions of consumers to the brand. We care deeply about building products that genuinely solve problems for pet owners while operating with high standards across every part of the business. We are building a company focused on long-term excellence, creating significant opportunities for highly capable people who want real and meaningful impact, and the ability to help shape the future of the company. About the Role This is a hands-on execution role focused 100% on active sourcing. You will proactively identify and engage high-quality talent across multiple functions and seniority levels using multiple sourcing channels, advanced search techniques, and thoughtful outreach. Success requires high-output execution, strong judgment, persistence, excellent communication, and the ability to operate with urgency in a fast-moving environment.
Responsibilities
Active Sourcing Proactively source candidates across multiple job boards, platforms, and sourcing channels Use advanced Boolean search techniques to identify strong talent Build pipelines across multiple functions and seniority levels Identify strong passive candidates Partner closely with recruiting and hiring managers to align on hiring needs. Candidate Outreach Write outbound messaging that drives candidate engagement Qualify candidates early in the process Move qualified candidates into the recruiting workflow Pipeline Management Maintain organized sourcing workflows and candidate tracking Continuously improve sourcing strategies and outreach quality Continuously iterate on sourcing methods, messaging, and targeting What Success Looks Like Consistently builds high-quality candidate pipelines Surfaces strong candidates quickly across multiple functions Generates strong response and assessment completion rates Operates with speed, consistency, and minimal oversight Raises the overall talent bar of the company over time
Requirements Must Have 1+ year of full-time active sourcing experience - mandatory Experience sourcing across multiple job boards and sourcing platforms Strong outbound recruiting and candidate outreach skills Experience using advanced Boolean search techniques Excellent written English communication skills Ability to manage multiple open searches simultaneously Strong Plus Experience sourcing across multiple functions and seniority levels Experience in high-growth, e-commerce, or performance-driven companies Familiarity with Linked In Recruiter and modern sourcing tools Work Requirements ⏰ Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST Workspace: Fixed, professional setup (no digital nomads) Output: Daily briefs and feedback loops (high consistency required)
Who This Role Is For (& Not For) This Role Is For You If: You enjoy the challenge of finding exceptional people before anyone else does You are naturally proactive and internally driven You move quickly, stay organized, and maintain high standards You enjoy performance-oriented environments with accountability You think recruiting is a high-leverage business function, not administrative work You enjoy improving systems, processes, and sourcing quality over time This Role Is NOT For You If: You need constant direction or external motivation You struggle with consistency and follow-through You are uncomfortable persuading passive candidates You treat recruiting as scheduling and coordination only
Compensation & Benefits Uproot Clean is a high ownership, high accountability environment with high standards for communication, speed, execution, and quality. We care far more about ability, judgment, and ownership than credentials or years of experience. Salary : Competitive base salary + performance-based bonus structure Significant autonomy with the ability to directly influence the company’s growth and direction Fully remote : work from anywhere PTO : 2 Weeks Flex Day : An additional quarterly day off dedicated to rest and recovery Thinking Day:
one dedicated day each quarter to step away from day-to-day execution and think deeply about your role, systems, ideas, and long-term impact Wellness Reimbursement: $100-$300/month, based on location, to help support your wellness. Pet Reimbursement: $40-100/month, based on location to help support parenting a pet. Coaching credits:
$1,000+/year for coaching, education, and professional development
Ready to Apply? If you are excited by high standards, proactive recruiting, and the challenge of building world-class talent pipelines, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Data & transportation analyst - advanced english
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data & transportation analyst - advanced english em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About HCLTech

HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.

To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit

Overall Responsibilities: The Transportation Specialist will be responsible for supporting our e-Commerce Transportation Operation for North America. The specialist will work with carriers, customers, and internal stakeholders to execute daily transportation management functions following documented SOPs and providing status updates to the hiring manager.

Core Responsibilities

1. Data Analysis & Shipment Integrity (Primary Focus) Proactive Monitoring: Query large datasets to identify lagging or \"\"at-risk\"\" shipments across sales, returns, and trade-in flows. Performance Reporting: Maintain and update centralized KPI boards and dashboards to ensure real-time visibility for internal stakeholders. SQL Management: Execute minor SQL queries to extract, filter, and audit transportation data from internal databases. Root Cause Analysis: Perform deep-dive investigations into weekly and monthly On-Time Delivery (OTD) fluctuations to identify systemic carrier or lane issues.

2. Transportation Operations Support (Secondary Focus) Escalation Management: Resolve complex shipment status inquiries by collaborating with carriers (UPS, Fed Ex, DHL), 3 PL partners, and Fulfillment teams. Master Data Maintenance: Support the Transportation Operations Manager in configuring and troubleshooting master data within the Transportation Management System (TMS). Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the data subject matter expert (SME) for ongoing logistics projects and process improvement initiatives.

Technical Requirements: Data Handling: 4-5 years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a data-intensive operations role. SQL Proficiency: Ability to write and execute basic SQL queries for data extraction and manipulation. Advanced Tooling: Expert-level proficiency in Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, complex formulas, data cleaning). Visualization: Experience maintaining or updating dashboards (e.g., Tableau, Looker, or Data Studio).

Operational Requirements: Industry Knowledge: Foundational understanding of parcel transportation or warehouse operations. Analytical Thinking: Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, identify trends in \"\"noisy\"\" data, and propose actionable solutions. Communication: Strong ability to present data findings in a clear, concise manner to both technical and non-technical audiences. Outstanding follow-through, time management and planning skills to deliver results. Able to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment as the market develops in unpredictable ways, producing high quality work and projecting a positive attitude.

Preferred Skills/Qualifications: Experience operating within a Transportation Management System (TMS). Prior experience working with major parcel carriers, such as DHL Express, UPS, and Fed Ex. Intermediate to Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (or Google Workspace), with working knowledge of SQL and Tableau. Prior Forecasting experience

Location: LATAM (Brazil) (Must align with US PST Time Zone)

Advanced English

We are one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in the world, with offices in over 60 countries and 224,000 employees

Our company is extremely diverse with 165 nationalities represented

We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues from all over the world

We are committed to your growth, offering learning and career development opportunities at all levels to help you find your unique brilliance.

Descrição da vaga

Atuar em equipe ágil no desenvolvimento e sustentação de produtos digitais, entregando valor de forma contínua e com qualidade, utilizando boas práticas de engenharia de software, garantindo a satisfação do cliente e a estabilidade das soluções em produção.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ruby on Rails Developer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Software Engineer I, L3 Messaging Team (Remote)

We're recruiting a Senior Software Engineer I to own the technical direction of a mission-critical messaging platform serving hundreds of healthcare organizations across the United States.


THE ROLE

Our client is a fast-growing, mission-driven organization transforming patient engagement at scale. They've built the leading platform powering communications for underserved populations, with proven impact reaching millions. Now they're looking for a seasoned backend engineer to lead their Messaging Team technical direction and mentor the next generation of engineering talent.


You'll own complex features end-to-end, drive architectural decisions that shape how millions of patient communications are delivered, and share team lead responsibilities with your peers. This is a highly visible, technically autonomous role with direct impact on health equity outcomes.


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years hands-on backend engineering with Ruby on Rails at scale
  • Deep experience building, maintaining, and scaling APIs and distributed systems
  • Advanced SQL skills and comfort working with large, complex datasets
  • Proven ability to independently own complex projects end-to-end and mentor junior engineers
  • Data-driven mindset you rely on evidence, not intuition
  • Excellent communicator (especially in fully remote environments)
  • Passionate about mission-driven work and advancing health equity


BONUS POINTS

  • Experience with Twilio, RCS, or MMS messaging platforms
  • Familiarity with healthcare compliance (TCPA, consent workflows, carrier regulations)
  • Tech stack: React, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud, Sidekiq
  • Event-driven architecture or high-throughput message delivery pipelines


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own and drive the technical direction of key messaging platform features
  • Design and build backend messaging systems (delivery pipelines, consent management, scheduling orchestration, API integrations)
  • Mentor L2 engineers, lead technical design discussions, and set engineering standards
  • Contribute to architectural decisions that shape messaging infrastructure at scale
  • Participate in on-call rotations (PagerDuty) and help improve team processes
  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, and Data teams


YOUR IMPACT

  • Month 1: Master the platform architecture and contribute to technical design discussions
  • Month 3: Independently deliver complex features with meaningful impact on patient outcomes
  • Month 6: Be recognized as a technical leader driving strategic initiatives across the engineering department

title: Full Stack Engineer (Python/React/AI tools)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer (Python/React/AI tools) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our engineering team builds agentic solutions that data and research teams utilize to transform petabytes of raw data into strategic intelligence. Our resulting product delivers accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers — ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies — depend on to drive high-stakes decisions.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture — recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years — emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting — it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high — always with purpose and intention

About The Role

We’re looking for a seasoned, high-output engineer who can develop our rapidly growing agent platform for our Revenue organization. This individual will sit on our Infrastructure team that builds AI-native solutions used by the entire company to find, convert, and better enable customers with the products we launch. The ideal candidate possesses 3+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, proficient data analytics skills, strong interest in agentic workflows, and 5+ years working on applications or codebases built with Python, Databricks, React/JavaScript/TypeScript, and AWS.

You’ll be responsible for production-grade systems that our customers and internal teams depend on daily. That means being responsive, reliable, and an excellent communicator — both when things are going well and especially when they’re not.

The ideal candidate treats AI coding tools as core infrastructure for how they work — not a novelty. You’ve shipped full-stack applications, you’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, and you are customer-obsessed in your approach to improving software.

As a Senior Software Engineer, You Will

  • Own features and systems end-to-end across multiple product surfaces — architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration
  • Architect and deliver solutions for our Revenue, Revenue Operations, and Business Development teams – including data tools, applications, and agentic orchestrators
  • Serve as a subject matter expert across the whole stack, and report directly to the Chief Architect, who will provide hands-on mentorship in cutting‑edge AI-native development, big data analytics, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Collaborate closely with the Revenue organization, discovering opportunities, projects, and areas to revamp critical business processes with AI
  • Drive initiatives across teams — you’re not waiting for a PM to write a spec; you’re in the room shaping what gets built and why
  • Leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex to improve personal productivity, ship trustworthy solutions faster through harness engineering, code quality, and documentation.
  • Produce clear documentation: create playbooks, docs, and training materials to institutionalize best practices.

You Are Likely To Succeed If

  • You have 5+ years of hands-on software development experience with a proven track record of shipping customer-facing applications — and the impact to show for it
  • You are stack-flexible: comfortable working across Python, TypeScript/React, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Databricks). You learn new tools fast and don’t let unfamiliar tech slow you down
  • You have an AI-accelerated workflow — you actively use AI coding tools to ship faster, not as an experiment, but as how you work every day
  • You thrive in ambiguity — you can take a vague business problem, break it down, and deliver a working solution without heavy-handed direction
  • You are a strong communicator who can work directly with non-technical stakeholders, translate between business needs and engineering tradeoffs, and drive alignment
  • You are responsive and reliable — you take ownership of production systems and communicate proactively, especially under pressure
  • You have a bias toward action and ownership — you see a problem, you fix it; you see an opportunity, you ship it
  • You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)

What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Information Technology Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview


Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.


Key Responsibilities


Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)

  • Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes.
  • Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes.
  • Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations.
  • Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools.

Automation, Integration & AI Implementation

  • Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript).
  • Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks.
  • Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.

IT Administration & Security

  • Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365).
  • Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access.
  • Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security.
  • Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.


Required Qualifications & Skills


Technical Experience:

  • 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures.
  • High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting.
  • Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows.
  • Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.


Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:

  • Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity.
  • Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms.
  • Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.


Benefits & Compensation

  • Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Risk Management Officer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
  • Net-worth monitoring;
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
  • Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English .
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Salesforce - Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor(a) Salesforce - Sênior em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei #fera, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • Inglês avançado/fluente para atuação com time Global.
  • Experiência com Experience Cloud .
  • Ter experiência em desenvolvimento e customização na plataforma Salesforce (Salesforce CRM, Lightning, Apex, Visualforce, Aura e LWC), seguindo boas práticas de governança e arquitetura.
  • Atuar em todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento (análise, implementação, testes, implantação, suporte e manutenção) da instância Salesforce.
  • Realizar codificação e integrações utilizando Apex, SOQL, SOSL e APIs REST, bem como ferramentas como Data Loader, Postman e recursos OOB (out of the box) do Salesforce.
  • Possuir conhecimento sólido em tecnologias web (JavaScript, HTML5 e CSS).
  • Utilizar controle de versionamento (Git/Bitbucket).
  • Colaborar com usuários-chave, arquitetos e consultores de negócio, realizando demonstrações e garantindo aderência aos requisitos funcionais e de experiência do usuário.
  • Elaborar documentação técnica, protótipos, fluxogramas, diagramas de sequência e planos de testes, assegurando qualidade e conformidade das entregas.
  • Realizar revisão de código e aplicar padrões consolidados de desenvolvimento (OOP, MVC/MVCS, Domain Layer Principle).


Diferenciais:


  • Espanhol avançado/fluente.
  • Ter experiência com Salesforce Commerce Cloud.
  • Possuir certificações Salesforce, como: Platform Developer I, Platform App Builder, Platform Developer II, Administrator, JavaScript Developer I, Data Architect, Sharing and Visibility Architect



- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

description:
